Build the query for the age uncertainty of a selection

Source: R/build_age_uncertainty_query.R
build_age_uncertainty_query.Rd

Build a lazy query of the rows of SampleUncertainty whose sample_id is in the selection data_source. The sample ids reach SQLite as the subquery sample_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT sample_id FROM ...), which SQLite evaluates once and serves through the index or the primary key on SampleUncertainty.sample_id.

Usage

build_age_uncertainty_query(data_source, sel_con)

Arguments

data_source

A lazy tbl_sql that holds the column sample_id.

sel_con

A SQLiteConnection to the Vault database.

Value

A lazy tbl_sql with the columns of SampleUncertainty, its age column renamed to age_uncertainty: sample_id, iteration and age_uncertainty. The rows are in no guaranteed order.

See also

get_age_uncertainty(), build_selected_id_sql()
